rows.grounds: the supreme reality Śiva, subject of the instruction
characterizes the nature of the teaching or attainment
addresses the recipient of the teaching

items.question: Why is instruction concerning Śiva affirmed to be difficult for the recipient?
premises: Śiva is the subject of the instruction.
The instruction is characterized as difficult.
The difficulty is emphatically directed to you.
items.inference: Receiving teaching about Śiva is inherently difficult for the seeker.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation between 'śiva' and 'upadeśa' in Kashmiri phrasing is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Śiva is indeed difficult—this is your teaching.
